page.layout: One column of running text. Above it, a centred italic title over two lines. The running head is at the top left and the page number at the top right. The signature and catchword sit at the foot.

main_text.head: Ex diversitate textus, ex aliys atque aliys Codi-cibus, & Photij astu, Synodum ementi-tam esse evincitur.
main_text.p: SIngula pro maiori rerum intelligentia examinentur. & ut de ingenio Photij ad similia confingenda promptissimo, ex quo argumentum non leue desumi potest, hanc quoque ex illo fonte enatam esse, cum omnia sibi concedat, & tota sit in eiusdem laudibus, ac in Ecclesiam meritis referendis, ut de Romanis Pontificibus clam mordendis, eorumque dignitate conculcanda, nihil dicamus, illa plane similis fabulae argumenta certissima sunt; & inter ea potissimum, hanc Synodum non unam eandemque in omnibus Codicibus haberi, sed varie, ac diverse, modo actionibus, & sententijs auctam, & diverso rerum exponendarum dicendi modo efformatam, modo multis demptis decurtatam. In Codicibus Vaticanis, & fautorum Photij sermonibus ad tædium usque verbosissimis, & eadem ad nauseam repetentibus, & Epistolarum, quibus Photij restitutioni, & illius moribus plauditur varia egestione prolixior, legentis aures onerat, & Actionibus quoq; adau-

page.notes: No marginal notes or reference marks. The text ends mid-word at "adau-" and the catchword "ctis" continues it on the next page. The signature "E 2" stands at the left of the foot. The title's line-end hyphens in "Codi-cibus" and "ementi-tam" are kept as printed. The reading "SIngula" depends on the large initial S, which is read as a plain S with the rest of the word joined to it.
